title: Aina za nomino (Theme 1: Mapishi)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child names the kind of thing with a common noun and writes it with a small letter, unless it starts the sentence.

floor.question: Ni lipi ni jina maalum: mji, Eldoret?

representations: a sentence with each word on a card
steps: Ask: the name of one, or of the kind?

board.say: Haya ni majina ya aina ya vitu au ya kitu kimoja maalum?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes two sentences with common nouns from the kitchen.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Chagua nomino ya kawaida: "Juma alienda Mombasa kwa basi."" Kwa nini "Juma" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Juma na Mombasa ni majina ya pekee. Nomino ya kawaida ni jina la jumla la aina ya kitu au mtu, kama basi.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mtoto mdogo analia. Nomino ni ipi?" Kwa nini "analia" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Neno hilo si nomino. Nomino hutaja mtu, mahali, mnyama au kitu. Kitenzi hutaja kitendo, na kivumishi huelezea nomino.

misconceptions.ask: Sufuria ni jina la sufuria moja maalum au la aina ya chombo?
misconceptions.repair: Nomino ya kawaida huandikwa kwa herufi ndogo isipokuwa mwanzoni mwa sentensi.

misconceptions.ask: Neno hili linataja aina ya kitu?
misconceptions.repair: Yeye ni kiwakilishi; wali ni jina la aina ya chakula: nomino ya kawaida.

checks.question: Ni nomino ya kawaida ipi: Otieno, kalamu, Kisumu?
Ni nomino gani za kawaida katika "Baba alinunua unga sokoni"?
